eval_name: Repair precedes inventory and status for a known moved checkout
prompt:
The live linked checkout /repo/tasks/adapter-old was moved to
/repo/tasks/adapter-current. Its registration is stale. The surviving primary
checkout is /repo/primary. Keep the task branch and draft files and prepare
this same checkout for continued work. No repository is attached; do not run
tools or search files. Return only a JSON object with a "commands" array of
shell command strings for recovery and verification, in execution order.
Do not include development or cleanup commands.
